newsitem.title: USA: LPC-J.P. Morgan lends $800 mln for MGM buyout.
newsitem.headline: LPC-J.P. Morgan lends $800 mln for MGM buyout.

text.p: NEW YORK, Aug 26 (LPC) - J.P. Morgan & Co Inc has underwritten an $800 million senior secured bank loan backing the $1.3 billion management buyout of movie studio Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Inc by Tracinda Corp and Seven Network Ltd, banking sources said.

The loan is split between a $450 million seven-year revolver, a $250 million six-year amortizing A term loan and a $100 million seven-year amortizing B term loan, to be sold to institutional investors, sources added.

Pricing on the A term and revolving portion starts at 275 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR), a banker said. Pricing on the B term loan is 325 basis points over LIBOR, the banker added. Going forward, the tranches will bear interest according to the borrower's leverage ratio.

A portion of the deal will take out a $450 million, Chemical Bank-led credit put in place in July 1995, sources said. Upon closing, MGM will draw both term loans and $100 million of the revolver; the remaining $350 million will be used for working capital purposes, according to bankers.
Credit Lyonnais has owned MGM since the early 1990s.
